title: Preventive Maintenance Procedures
contentStatus: Draft for DiFacto review. Title and content to be confirmed.

sections.title: Why Preventive Maintenance Matters
learningObjectives: Understand the economic logic of preventive maintenance
Recognize the relationship between scheduled maintenance and uptime
sections.content: Preventive maintenance exists because waiting for a failure to occur before acting is more expensive than preventing it - both in unplanned downtime and often in repair cost, since a caught-early issue is usually cheaper to fix than a failure that's cascaded. The goal isn't zero maintenance activity; it's predictable, scheduled activity that keeps unplanned downtime low.

sections.title: Building a Maintenance Schedule
learningObjectives: Understand the general principle behind maintenance scheduling intervals
Recognize that schedules are typically based on usage, not just calendar time
sections.content: Preventive maintenance intervals are generally set based on a combination of time elapsed and actual usage (operating hours, cycles completed) - a heavily used unit may need attention sooner than a lightly used one on the same calendar schedule. Specific interval recommendations for MoRo components will be confirmed against DiFacto's maintenance documentation and added here.

keyTerms.note: The time or usage between one scheduled maintenance task and the next.
The total time a unit has actually been running, used to schedule maintenance by usage rather than by calendar.

video.title: Time and usage in 30 seconds
video.transcript: Setting maintenance intervals, in 30 seconds. Intervals are set from time elapsed and actual usage. Usage means operating hours and cycles completed. A heavily used unit may need attention sooner. Both count together, not either one alone. Specific intervals: to be confirmed against DiFacto documentation.

sections.title: Mechanical Component Checks
learningObjectives: Understand the general categories of mechanical inspection
Know which mechanical components are checked for wear
sections.content: Mechanical preventive checks generally cover wheel condition and wear, structural fasteners (confirming nothing has loosened from vibration over time), and drive component function. Specific inspection procedures and acceptable wear tolerances will be confirmed against DiFacto's technical documentation.

sections.title: Sensor and Software Checks
learningObjectives: Understand the general scope of sensor maintenance
Recognize why software/firmware checks are part of preventive maintenance
sections.content: LiDAR and other sensors benefit from periodic cleaning and calibration verification, since even minor obstruction or drift affects navigation accuracy over time. Software and firmware checks confirm MoRo is running current, supported versions - this is preventive in the sense that staying current avoids accumulating technical debt that becomes harder to address later.

keyTerms.note: Verifying that a sensor's readings are still accurate.
The low-level software built into a device that controls how its hardware works.

sections.title: Performing and Recording a Maintenance Visit
learningObjectives: Understand the general workflow of a preventive maintenance visit
Know that a completed visit should produce a documented record
sections.content: A preventive maintenance visit follows a checklist appropriate to the schedule point (e.g., an early-life check covers different items than a check at much higher operating hours), with each item confirmed and any deviation noted - not just checked off without genuine inspection. The visit concludes with a documented record, consistent with the documentation practice covered in Module 1.

keyTerms.note: A list of items to inspect at a given point in the schedule, each one confirmed and recorded.

sections.title: When Preventive Maintenance Reveals a Problem
learningObjectives: Understand how a preventive check can surface a predictive or corrective need
Recognize the appropriate response when this happens
sections.content: Sometimes a routine preventive check reveals something beyond normal wear - early signs of a developing issue. When this happens, the response shifts from the preventive checklist to the predictive and diagnostic methodology covered in later modules. Catching this during scheduled preventive work, rather than waiting for a failure, is exactly the value preventive maintenance is meant to provide.

questions.question: According to the lesson, where does the extra cost of waiting for failure come from?
options: The price of replacement parts rising over time
Unplanned downtime and, often, a costlier repair once a failure has cascaded
Scheduled visits taking longer after a failure
questions.feedback: Correct. Unplanned downtime and cascaded failures tend to cost more than scheduled prevention.

questions.question: Two units are on the same calendar schedule. One has far more operating hours. What follows?
options: Both are due on the same date
Neither needs attention until a fault appears
The heavily used unit may need attention sooner
questions.feedback: Correct. Intervals combine elapsed time and actual usage, so units that work harder may need attention sooner.

questions.question: Why do sensors benefit from periodic cleaning and calibration checks?
options: Sensors fail suddenly, and cleaning prevents that
Even minor obstruction or drift affects navigation accuracy over time
Cleaning is needed only after a navigation fault is reported
questions.feedback: Correct. Sensor performance can degrade gradually, affecting navigation if not checked.

questions.question: A checklist item looks the same as last visit and time is short. What does the lesson require?
options: Skip it and note it for the next visit
Inspect it and note any deviation
questions.feedback: Correct. A checklist only has value if items are genuinely inspected, not just marked complete.

questions.question: What should happen if a preventive check reveals signs of a developing issue?
options: Ignore it since it's outside the preventive checklist scope
Wait until the next scheduled visit
Shift to predictive/diagnostic methodology to address what was found
questions.feedback: Correct. Catching developing issues during preventive work is exactly the value it provides.
